title: Mourning Run does not disappoint in his recent song "World Gone Mad"
htmlContent:
American-based superstar Mourning Run released his recent single "World Gone Mad." The unique artist has a story like no other artist in the industry.

Mourning Run's "World Gone Mad" is the second track of his recent album "Great Tribulatia," released on the 24th of December, 2022. His current song is filled with a bright energy that makes you fan out to the big-time sound that stands out from everything you hear today.
